scope: Existing company deployment reached from separate newly installed WindowsServer2019 x64 lab VM using normal HTTPS validation and isolated lab DNS. This is a network/trust check, not native client qualification.
limitations: Public CA material was explicitly trusted and isolated lab DNS configured on the disposable guest; this does not establish Internet DNS, public ACME or public reachability.
The saved lab transport profile points to parallel-test ports without active parallel listeners; installed transport components use their normal ports. Transport testing remains open.
No native device enrollment, technician login, direct/relay session or update rollout was exercised.
Machine-specific addresses, configuration and keys remain outside the repository.
